paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of average lagging for four different models. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” is a linear scale ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick labels spaced at 2.5 units. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” also follows a linear scale, with values ranging from approximately 26.8 to 32.8, and tick labels are spaced at 1 unit. A solid red line represents the Consistency-CE model, beginning at approximately 28.2 at x=2.5 and increasing to approximately 32.3 at x=10.0. A dashed purple line displays the Inconsistency-CE model, initiating at approximately 26.8 at x=2.5 and rising to approximately 29.6 at x=10.0. A solid blue line represents the Inconsistency-MP model, starting at approximately 26.3 at x=2.5 and reaching approximately 29.2 at x=10.0. Finally, a red star-shaped marker indicates the Consistency-Bi model and begins at approximately 27.9 at x=2.5, increasing to approximately 32.8 at x=10.0.
